movie.title: Chum
movie.overview: A newlywed couple joins friends on a Mediterranean yacht excursion, only to find themselves caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer in their midst-transforming a sun-drenched escape into a fight for survival.

reviews.author: Sierbahnn
reviews.content:
This looks cheaper than it is.
They got some money together for this, but didn't spend it where it needed to be spent, and as a result the movie looks cheap. The nature-footage of sharks swimming around is nice and all, but the moment your switch to the cgi shark this just takes a dive. The casting is decent, but the writing and directing isn't doing anything, and the story is thin, at best.
This is one best to avoid.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A newlywed couple's sun-soaked Mediterranean yacht vacation turns into a nightmare as they face both a deadly shark in the water and a psychopathic killer on board.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: What begins as a relaxing Mediterranean getaway for a newlywed couple and their close friends quickly devolves into a desperate struggle for survival. Trapped aboard a luxury yacht, the group discovers that a ruthless killer is hidden among them, orchestrating chaos from within. To make matters worse, a predatory shark stalks the surrounding waters, cutting off any chance of escape. As trust rapidly erodes, the survivors must navigate both human malice and nature's deadliest hunter.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seeking the ultimate romantic getaway, a newlywed couple invites a group of close friends on an exclusive yacht voyage across the picturesque Mediterranean Sea. The initial atmosphere of luxury and celebration quickly sours as unsettling incidents begin to occur aboard the vessel. Tensions rise sharply when a crew member vanishes under suspicious circumstances, forcing the group to confront a terrifying reality: a psychopathic killer is operating in their midst. Paranoia spreads rapidly as long-buried secrets, jealousy, and motives surface, causing once-loyal friends to turn on one another. Attempts to call for help or flee to safety are shattered when the yacht's engine is sabotaged, leaving them stranded in open water. Adding to the horror, a massive and relentless killer shark is drawn to the vessel, turning the surrounding sea into a deadly trap. Stranded between the ruthless aquatic predator outside and the calculating murderer on deck, the group's numbers dwindle rapidly. Every decision becomes a heart-pounding gamble between trusting a potential murderer or risking the infested waters. Ultimately, the remaining survivors must unravel the killer's true identity and pull off a desperate gambit to escape the dual nightmare.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the gorgeous, sun-drenched backdrop of the Mediterranean Sea, 'Chum' is a high-stakes horror-drama that blends psychological thriller elements with creature-feature suspense. The plot follows a newlywed couple celebrating their union alongside a small group of friends aboard a private yacht. The dream vacation morphs into a suffocating pressure cooker when a series of deliberate, malicious acts reveals that someone on board is a cold-blooded killer. Cut off from communication and unable to reach the mainland, the stranded group faces an agonizing psychological game of survival where anyone could be the murderer. The terror escalates exponentially as a monstrous shark begins circling the vessel, preying on anyone forced into the water and blocking all routes of escape. With nowhere to run and no one left to trust, the characters are forced to confront the darkest depths of human deception alongside the primal terror of nature's ultimate ocean predator.

story_structure.resolution: The immediate threat is neutralized, leaving the remaining survivors to endure the emotional and physical aftermath of the harrowing ordeal.
